numerical_examples: All new numeric examples explicitly synthetic, no unverified AKM device values.
formula_review: Current bias VH=RH/t*IB*Bperp, |RH|~1/(nq), carrier/wiring sign convention explicit
Voltage bias VH~muH*(W/L)*VB*Bperp, ideal model only
Power examples I^2R and V^2/R do not assert measured temperature rise
BH=BOP-BRP only for same device and conditions; cross-population extrema are not actual single-device hysteresis
Local position error delta_x~(deltaV/S)/(dB/dx), local monotonic approximation only
atan2 cancels common positive amplitude A(T)>0, not additive offset, relative gain or phase error
diagram_advice: Show bias current, perpendicular B and transverse differential voltage as orthogonal quantities with explicit sign conventions
Raw element has one excitation pair and one differential measurement pair, not two independent ground-referenced outputs
For a low-active positive unipolar example: rising B crosses BOP to output low; falling B crosses BRP to output high
For a bipolar latch example explicitly label BOP>0, BRP<0; state held between them; startup requires datasheet
